metadata.scope: English-first research on realistic AI monk video avatars such as Yang Mun. The public directory contains 4 evidence-reviewed video personas. The 75-record research archive retains 69 pending candidates and 2 excluded illustrated/watercolor channels. This is not a complete census.
metadata.license: CC BY 4.0 for Anicca-authored summaries, annotations, and the database compilation. Third-party content, names, marks, profile data, and linked media remain with their owners.
methodology: Publish a synthetic monk video persona only after an explicit included scope review supported by creator/provider disclosure or credible reporting with account-attributed video evidence. Keep missing-scope and pending records in the research archive; an image or discovery lead alone is insufficient.
Do not merge accounts on similar names alone. Unknown handles, creators, launch dates, and product URLs remain null with a reason.

Store platform, source URL, capture date, and metric beside each number. Instagram followers, YouTube subscribers, views, seller counters, creator statements, orders, and net profit are different measures.
Summarize video structure without storing full scripts, captions, or downloaded media. Video URLs point to the original platform.
User-provided screenshots are identified as such; their calendar capture date is unknown unless the screenshot itself shows it.

Screenshot-visible handles seed unverified leads. Public metadata is dated and source-linked when read through connected research providers. Direct Instagram probes stopped after its robots notice was reviewed; use authorized/connected data access for continuing collection. Unknown AI origin, creator, language and revenue are not inferred from appearance or audience size.

Audience ordering uses each platform's latest numeric followers/subscribers, never views or historical peaks. All-platform comparisons use the largest single observed audience; cross-platform audiences are not added and may overlap. Provider-rounded figures are labelled in each snapshot status.
metadata.views_order: Largest observed view count among sampled videos on the selected platform, not channel totals or recent-period reach. See each sample date and source.
metadata.revenue_order: Latest reported three-month USD gross-revenue observation, descending. Other currencies, periods, profit, buyout offers, seller counters and prices are excluded. Missing values sort last; claims are not audited sales.
metadata.audience_order: Latest numeric followers/subscribers per platform; largest single audience when platform=all. Audiences are not added. Views and revenue claims are not audience counts. See each snapshot for date, source and rounding.
